description:
Tarsier Studios are back with a new chapter in the dread-filled co-op horror adventure game REANIMAL.

This DLC features two brand new characters: The Soldier and the Prisoner! They must survive the war-ravaged streets of a once-familiar place, stumbling blindly down a rabbit hole that will change their lives forever. Explore previously unseen areas of the world of REANIMAL, on foot and otherwise, and discover that while war can be hell, some experiences are even worse.

description:
Introducing the Ardennian automotive expert with attitude! 

As you make your way through the Galactic League on your journey to become League Champion, you will undoubtedly encounter Hibi in the Paddock. Hibi is Shade's mechanic and her enthusiasm for engineering is positively infectious! 

In the first episode of the Under the Hood with Hibi series, Hibi discusses the features, benefits, and build possibilities of landspeeders with Shade. Could this be the perfect vehicle for your racing style? Watch the full episode to find out and keep an eye out for Episode 2.

STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ launches worldwide on October 6th. Pre-order today for XBOX Series X|S.

author: XBOX
description:
From the shadows of the New York underground comes the newest power-hungry villain. 🔥
 
Cloaked in a cursed mantle, Parker Robbins lost his faith in heroes alongside his father and his world's Captain America - replacing it with an insatiable appetite for the power to change the world. Stealing an enchanted cloak from the Vault, he remade himself as the feared crime lord, The Hood.
 
Now, The Hood treads a perilous path through channeling dark magic, devouring enemy firepower, and transforming into a demonic abomination of cosmic magic and steel. Even after a deadly clash in Thebes with Gambit and Doom 2099 over the Tablet of Death and Entropy, his dark journey is far from over...
 
📅 Season 9.5 arrives on August 7th, 2026 UTC!
 
Dare to dream... 🕯️
